description: Elastic Security SIEM alert rules — Web Application Attack Chain Detection

rules.name: Web Chain — SQLi UNION SELECT information_schema Enumeration
rules.description: Detects SQL injection with UNION SELECT against information_schema tables, the schema extraction phase of a SQLi-to-privilege-escalation chain
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND network.protocol:"http" AND http.request.body_wildcard:*UNION*SELECT*information_schema*

rules.name: Web Chain — SQLi Credential Extraction from User Table
rules.description: Detects SQL injection extracting password hashes from user/authentication tables
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND network.protocol:"http" AND http.request.body_wildcard:*SELECT*FROM*users*password*

rules.name: Web Chain — SQLi xp_cmdshell/LOAD_FILE OS Command Execution
rules.description: Detects SQL injection leading to OS command execution via xp_cmdshell, LOAD_FILE, INTO OUTFILE, or UTL_FILE
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND network.protocol:"http" AND http.request.body_wildcard:(*xp_cmdshell* OR *LOAD_FILE* OR *INTO OUTFILE* OR *UTL_FILE*)

rules.name: Web Chain — XSS Cookie Theft via document.cookie
rules.description: Detects XSS attacks accessing document.cookie for session token theft
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND network.protocol:"http" AND http.request.body_wildcard:*document.cookie*

rules.name: Web Chain — XSS Session Token Exfiltration via Image/Fetch
rules.description: Detects XSS exfiltrating session tokens via Image tag or fetch/XMLHttpRequest
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND network.protocol:"http" AND http.request.body_wildcard:(*document.cookie* AND *new Image* OR *fetch* OR *XMLHttpRequest*)

rules.name: Web Chain — Session Token in Outbound Request After XSS
rules.description: Detects stolen session tokens appearing in outbound HTTP requests after XSS exploitation
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND network.protocol:"http" AND http.response.status_code:200 AND http.response.body_wildcard:*PHPSESSID* OR *JSESSIONID* OR *ASP.NET_SessionId*

rules.name: Web Chain — SSRF Cloud Metadata Access (AWS/GCP/Azure IMDS)
rules.description: Detects SSRF accessing cloud instance metadata services for credential harvesting
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND network.protocol:"http" AND http.request.body_wildcard:(*169.254.169.254* OR *metadata.google.internal* OR *metadata.azure.app*) AND (*meta-data* OR *computeMetadata* OR *metadata/instance*)

rules.name: Web Chain — SSRF AWS IAM Credential Request via IMDSv1
rules.description: Detects SSRF requesting IAM security credentials from AWS instance metadata service
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND network.protocol:"http" AND http.request.body_wildcard:*169.254.169.254* AND *iam/security-credentials*

rules.name: Web Chain — AWS IAM Credential Exfiltration After SSRF
rules.description: Detects AWS access key IDs (AKIA prefix) in outbound HTTP requests after SSRF credential theft
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND network.protocol:"http" AND http.request.body_wildcard:*AKIA*

rules.name: Web Chain — Path Traversal to Config/Credential File Access
rules.description: Detects path traversal attempts targeting configuration files, databases, and credential stores
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND network.protocol:"http" AND http.request.body_wildcard:(*../* AND *(*etc/passwd* OR *.env* OR *wp-config* OR *config.yml* OR *database.yml* OR *appsettings.json*))

rules.name: Web Chain — Database Credential in Response After Path Traversal
rules.description: Detects database connection strings and credentials exposed in HTTP responses after path traversal
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND network.protocol:"http" AND http.response.body_wildcard:(*jdbc:mysql* OR *ConnectionString*Password* OR *DB_PASSWORD* OR *redis://*auth*)

rules.name: Web Chain — Web Shell Upload via File Upload
rules.description: Detects web shell uploads (PHP/JSP/ASP) with shell-like command patterns in upload content
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND network.protocol:"http" AND http.request.method:"POST" AND http.request.body_wildcard:(*filename* AND (*.php* OR *.jsp* OR *.aspx*) AND (*cmd* OR *shell* OR *backdoor* OR *execute*))

rules.name: Web Chain — Reverse Shell via Web Shell
rules.description: Detects reverse shell commands executed via web shells (bash -i, nc, python socket, PowerShell reverse TCP)
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND network.protocol:"http" AND http.request.body_wildcard:(*bash -i*dev/tcp* OR *nc -e* OR *python*socket*connect* OR *powershell*reverse*tcp*)

rules.name: Web Chain — HTTP Request Smuggling CL.TE Conflict
rules.description: Detects HTTP request smuggling via double Content-Length headers (CL.TE conflict)
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND network.protocol:"http" AND http.request.headers_wildcard:*Content-Length* AND _marker:double_content_length

rules.name: Web Chain — HTTP Request Smuggling TE.CL Conflict
rules.description: Detects HTTP request smuggling via Transfer-Encoding: chunked with Content-Length (TE.CL conflict)
rules.type: event.category:"network" AND network.protocol:"http" AND http.request.headers:"Transfer-Encoding: chunked" AND http.request.headers:"Content-Length"

rules.name: Web Chain — JWT None Algorithm Auth Bypass
rules.description: Detects JWT tokens using 'none' algorithm to bypass authentication
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND network.protocol:"http" AND http.request.headers_wildcard:(*Bearer eyJ* AND *alg*none*)

rules.name: Web Chain — JWT Admin Role After None Algorithm Bypass
rules.description: Detects admin/superadmin role claims in JWT tokens after algorithm confusion attack
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND network.protocol:"http" AND http.request.headers_wildcard:*Bearer eyJ* AND http.request.body_wildcard:(*role*admin* OR *isAdmin*true* OR *privilege*super*)

rules.name: Web Chain — IDOR Sequential Enumeration
rules.description: Detects automated sequential access to API endpoints with incrementing numeric IDs (IDOR/BOLA)
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND network.protocol:"http" AND http.request.uri_wildcard:/api/v*/users/* OR /api/v*/accounts/* OR /api/v*/orders/*

rules.name: Web Chain — BOLA Mass PII Extraction After IDOR
rules.description: Detects mass PII extraction from API responses after IDOR/BOLA enumeration
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND network.protocol:"http" AND http.response.status_code:200 AND http.response.body_wildcard:(*email* AND *ssn* OR *phone* OR *address* OR *date_of_birth*)

rules.name: Web Chain — XXE OOB Exfiltration via External Entity
rules.description: Detects XXE attacks using external entity references with HTTP/DNS callbacks for data exfiltration
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND network.protocol:"http" AND http.request.body_wildcard:(*<!ENTITY* AND *SYSTEM* AND *http*)

rules.name: Web Chain — XXE Parameter Entity Injection for File Read
rules.description: Detects XXE parameter entity injection targeting local files via DTD
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND network.protocol:"http" AND http.request.body_wildcard:(*<!ENTITY %* AND *SYSTEM* AND *file://*)

rules.name: Web Chain — Prototype Pollution via __proto__/constructor.prototype
rules.description: Detects prototype pollution attacks targeting __proto__ or constructor.prototype in JSON payloads
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND network.protocol:"http" AND http.request.method:"POST" AND http.request.body_wildcard:(*__proto__* OR *constructor*prototype*)

rules.name: Web Chain — Prototype Pollution to RCE via Gadget Chain
rules.description: Detects prototype pollution leading to RCE through polluted prototype with command execution properties
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND network.protocol:"http" AND http.request.body_wildcard:(*__proto__* AND *isAdmin* OR *command* OR *exec* OR *shell* OR *child_process*)

rules.name: Web Chain — CORS Null Origin with Credentials
rules.description: Detects CORS misconfiguration allowing null origin with credentials, enabling cross-origin data theft
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND network.protocol:"http" AND http.response.headers:"Access-Control-Allow-Origin: null" AND http.response.headers:"Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true"

rules.name: Web Chain — CORS Reflected Origin with Wildcard Methods
rules.description: Detects CORS misconfiguration reflecting any origin with credentials and permissive methods
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND network.protocol:"http" AND http.response.headers:"Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true" AND http.response.headers_wildcard:*Access-Control-Allow-Origin: http* AND http.response.headers_wildcard:*Access-Control-Allow-Methods*
